🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

Style mixed / no clear leadership: nine sectors are positive, but major stock-level divergences argue against a strong style call.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

BEARISH: NOW, BELOW TREND (1W: -30.15% | 1M: -18.16%), if weak revenue-related sentiment weighs further; GOOGL, BELOW TREND (1W: -12.46% | 1M: -17.51%), if selling continues.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price-level data was not supplied, so specific numeric levels cannot be established. Watch for follow-through or failure of the recent moves in NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -30.15% | 1M: -18.16%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -12.46% | 1M: -17.51%), and LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +26.38%).

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NOW (-55): key revenue measure missed; BELOW TREND (1W: -30.15% | 1M: -18.16%), sentiment confirmed. CAT (-45): price-target reduction; BELOW TREND (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -19.96%), also confirmed; MSFT (-40): downgrade to Neutral, but ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +3.36%), a price-sentiment divergence.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with 9/11 sectors positive and broad leadership among the selected top performers; style mixed, with no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership. Relative strength includes LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +26.38%) and EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.82% | 1M: +2.48%). Major stock-level divergence and NOW’s negative sentiment remain risks; watch for trend breaks before making a stronger directional call.
